definitions.name: Thermal

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: 16-bit-addressed I2C words. Official driver loads factory EEPROM calibration from 0x2400, configures 0x800D, polls status 0x8000, and reads a frame block at 0x0400 with 832 words before calculating 32x24 temperatures.

registers.encoding: 16-bit register address and words; driver compensation required

gaps: The proposed temperature-field fixture needs calibrated raw frame encoding and EEPROM consistency; it is not a host-side override of get_frame().
